cases.name: Juanita Katherine James
cases.about: Her obituary said, "She was deeply rooted in Kitzmiller and supported many of the town’s events and projects. She had great affection for the community and was always ready with a kind word and support. As an animal lover, she had many pets over her life and rescued several injured wild animals as well. Juanita was a talented and prolific artist, and her artwork can be viewed in key areas of Kitzmiller."
